Unit 4: Cell Growth and Division — 7th Grade Life Science (Period 3 & 4):
- Core Objective: Students will identify the four sequential stages of mitosis (Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, Telophase) using prepared microscope slides.
- Bellringer (5 mins): Sketch chromosomes lining up in the center of a cell.
- Direct Instruction (15 mins): Interactive whiteboard presentation contrasting somatic mitosis with gamete meiosis. Emphasize cytokinesis furrowing.
- Laboratory Activity (25 mins): Pairs examine Allium (onion root tip) longitudinal section slides under 400x total magnification. Each student must sketch and label at least three cells in active anaphase.
- Homework: Complete workbook pages 112-115 for Friday review.
